message.content:
This is the Tint (WGSL compiler) project. The vulnerability is about a one-letter typo causing out-of-bounds memory access when dumping the layout of a struct within a struct that includes field alignment padding, specifically if the inner struct has more members than the outer struct, and an invalid storage class layout is being output.

Let me explore the relevant code. The description mentions "dumping the layout of a struct" - this is likely in the inspector or a layout dump function. Let me search.
